dossier.scp_unleashed.179.title: Sister of the Sun
dossier.scp_unleashed.179.caption: SCP-179 beside the Sun, imaged from orbit.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-179 cannot be contained and remains in close solar orbit. Observation is maintained through Foundation satellites, and any satellite terminal keyed to its coordinates may be used to view it.
Personnel are not to attempt contact by any means. **Any change in the posture of SCP-179 is to be reported at once.**
Coordinates for SCP-179 are issued with this file and are to be handled as restricted material.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-179 is a humanoid entity of feminine appearance located near the Sun. Its body is entirely black and featureless, save for a column of luminous gold markings resembling astronomical symbols, which runs from its brow down the centre of its body, and two small points of light in place of eyes.
The hair of SCP-179 is extremely long and drifts about it as though weightless, trailing well past the length of its body. SCP-179 shows no sign of harm despite its closeness to the solar surface.
SCP-179 is almost always motionless, floating with its face turned toward the Sun. It does not respond to light, radio or any other signal directed at it.

page.title: Addendum 179-1: Gestures
page.text: On rare occasions SCP-179 has been observed to turn from the Sun, look toward Earth and raise one arm. %rThe circumstances of these gestures are withheld.%r Observers agree that the gestures do not appear hostile.

page.title: Addendum 179-2: Observer's Note
page.text: I have watched her for eleven years. She has never once looked our way without a reason. Whatever she is, I believe she is on our side.
